facts_raw.Funding / Support: $10K equity-free Fellowship grant OR up to $250K founder funding pathway
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: $10K on Fellowship acceptance; $250K pathway on investment acceptance/documentation
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: $10K Fellowship = 0% equity. $250K pathway: $125K post-money SAFE for 8% + optional $125K uncapped MFN SAFE if founder relocates to SF and incorporates Delaware C-Corp.
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: US pathway; founder must be able to participate in San Francisco residency. Optional second $125K requires Delaware C-Corp and SF relocation.
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Exceptional individual ready to build or explore; sector agnostic. US program offers a full-time funding path and a lower-commitment Fellowship path.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Three months living/working in San Francisco for the US funding path; Fellowship also includes three months of SF housing/community.
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes if able to participate in US; specific immigration eligibility must be handled separately
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Rolling; US Funding & Fellowships listed for 2026
facts_raw.Application Materials: Online application followed by interviews with EF US team, advisors, alumni and leadership.
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-idea–pre-seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；已经是成熟公司、团队与商业模型固定且只想拿融资
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore: very strong for high-potential individuals pre-idea/pre-team. Treat the $10K Fellowship and $250K investment path as distinct capital products.
